items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And all the different dance teams and acts, big time acts, acts that had played the RKO vaudeville circuit and all of that, Norman Thomas' Quintet

ctx.x: Curtis Mosely had had a hell of a band at one time out of Los Angeles. And so they needed a drummer. Because he played drums himself, but he was pretty much over the hill at that particular time.

So they needed a drummer, so I joined them. And chorus girls, 20, 15 chorus girls, and all this type of a thing, and all the different dance teams and acts, big time acts, acts that had played the RKO vaudeville circuit and all of that, Norman Thomas' Quintet, and they had very good acts. And then the show things, and so this was really my introduction to shows, see, then with the big show, we played the Strand and Lake Theatre here in Chicago. We played the Old Stratford Theatre, I don't know whether you…
But where -- you say you went on the road with it.
